title: Shortfilm Festival Oberhausen
subtitle: Melodies of Barking Dogs
content:
In January 2024 'Melodies of Barking Dogs' had its premiere at Filmfestival Max Ophüls Preis and was shown at La Cinémathèque française in Paris. It was also selected for the german competition of the International Shortfilm Festival Oberhausen and will be available in Arte's online media library until 2026.
